items.title: Meloni reportedly on shortlist to be EU's negotiator with Russia
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 23 OTT - Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni is on a shortlist of five figures being considered for the role of the EU's negotiator with Vladimir Putin's Russia in talks to end the war in Ukraine, The Daily Telegraph reported on Friday, citing diplomatic sources. The other figures on the shortlist are Finland's President Alexander Stubb, Czech President Petr Pavel, Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, the British newspaper said.
